# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

We want the asdf-extras community to be welcoming, respectful, and useful to
everyone, regardless of background, experience, identity, or point of view.
Participation in this project is expected to support that environment.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and considerate in discussions and reviews.
- Critique ideas and code constructively; do not attack people.
- Assume good intent while remaining open to feedback about impact.
- Keep discussions focused on the project and make space for others to
  participate.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, or personal attacks.
- Insults, intimidation, or deliberately disruptive conduct.
- Publishing another person's private information without permission.
- Any other conduct that would be inappropriate in a professional community.

## Scope and enforcement

This code applies in project spaces, including issues, pull requests, reviews,
and other spaces where someone is representing the project.

Project maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing these
expectations. They may remove or edit harmful content and may warn, restrict, or
exclude participants based on the severity and pattern of behavior.

## Reporting

Report conduct that violates this code privately to the project maintainer
through [@eihu0F on GitHub](https://github.com/eihu0F). Include links and a
description of what happened. Reports will be handled as confidentially as
practical. Do not use public issues for sensitive reports.
